decision.reason: [ev-897e37ab14ab] is a marketing-style highlights section that bundles at least four distinct features: compositions can include any Kubernetes resource, XRs/MRs are namespaced by default, a new Operation type, and managed resource filtering. The text is also cut off partway through. It does not identify one subject or change type, and it says nothing about which existing environments are exposed or what happens to them if operators do nothing. For example, it does not say what happens to existing cluster-scoped XRs/MRs under "namespaced by default." The change needs to be split into separate items, each backed by the specific release-note or upgrade-guide sections that describe it concretely.
